limitations: Continuum quantum reactant normalization only; no transition state or recrossing.
No nuclear-spin/exchange statistical weights; all J have multiplicity 2J+1.
Finite radial Dirichlet boxes and retained levels are checked by refinement, not assumed exact.
The 0.6-bohr wall stress test modifies the physical Hamiltonian; its nonzero shift is reported separately from fixed-domain numerical convergence.
A finite-bead ring-polymer comparison needs its own bead extrapolation.
A beadwise radial wall and an upper centroid bound do not define identical finite-P domains; this is the common physical bound-state limit.

source.paper: A. I. Boothroyd, W. J. Keogh, P. G. Martin, M. R. Peterson, A refined H3 potential energy surface, J. Chem. Phys. 104, 7139-7152 (1996)
